movies.overview: Ishaan Awasthi is an eight-year-old whose world is filled with wonders that no one else seems to appreciate. Colours, fish, dogs, and kites don't seem important to the adults, who are much more interested in things like homework, marks, and neatness. Ishaan cannot seem to get anything right in class; he is then sent to boarding school, where his life changes forever.

movies.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
movies.cast: Spencer Tracy, Richard Widmark, Maximilian Schell, Burt Lancaster, Marlene Dietrich, Judy Garland
movies.overview: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner.

movies.title: Toto, Peppino, and the Hussy
movies.cast: Totò, Peppino De Filippo, Dorian Gray, Teddy Reno, Vittoria Crispo, Mario Castellani
movies.overview: Antonio, Peppino and Lucia are three brothers who live in the country near Naples. Lucia's son, Gianni, goes to Naples to study medicine, but there he knows a ballet dancer. They fall in love and, when she goes to Milan, Gianni follows her. Informed of this and afraid that their nephew will stop studying, the three Caponi brothers leave for Milan to persuade Gianni to come back and continue studying and abandon the "Malafemmina" (bad girl).

movies.title: American Beauty
movies.cast: Kevin Spacey, Annette Bening, Thora Birch, Wes Bentley, Mena Suvari, Peter Gallagher
movies.overview: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend.

movies.title: Barry Lyndon
movies.cast: Ryan O'Neal, Marisa Berenson, Patrick Magee, Hardy Krüger, Steven Berkoff, Gay Hamilton
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond Barry into the noble Barry Lyndon.

movies.title: The 400 Blows
movies.cast: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Claire Maurier, Albert Rémy, Georges Flamant, Patrick Auffay, Robert Beauvais
movies.overview: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.

movies.title: All Too Well: The Short Film
movies.original_title: All Too Well: The Short Film
movies.cast: Sadie Sink, Dylan O'Brien, Taylor Swift, Jake Lyon, Shawn Levy, Rashauna Eastman
movies.overview: Short film featuring the extended version of the song “All Too Well” by Taylor Swift. A troubled couple's romance blossoms before it eventually falls apart.

movies.title: El Infierno
movies.cast: Damián Alcázar, Joaquín Cosío, Ernesto Gómez Cruz, María Rojo, Elizabeth Cervantes, Jorge Zárate
movies.overview: After being deported back to Mexico, a man has no choice but to join the vicious drug cartel that has corrupted his hometown in order to survive.

movies.title: Ayla: The Daughter of War
movies.cast: İsmail Hacıoğlu, Kim Seol, Çetin Tekindor, Ali Atay, Murat Yildirim, Taner Birsel
movies.overview: In 1950, amidst the ravages of the Korean War, Sergeant Süleyman stumbles upon a a half-frozen little girl, with no parents and no help in sight and he risks his own life to save her, smuggling her into his army base and out of harm’s way.

movies.title: The Red Shoes
movies.cast: Anton Walbrook, Marius Goring, Moira Shearer, Robert Helpmann, Léonide Massine, Albert Bassermann
movies.overview: A fledgling ballerina falls in love with a brilliant composer, but the jealous head of the ballet company plots to drive them apart.

movies.title: Gran Torino
movies.cast: Clint Eastwood, Christopher Carley, Bee Vang, Ahney Her, Brian Haley, Geraldine Hughes
movies.overview: Disgruntled Korean War veteran Walt Kowalski sets out to reform his neighbor, Thao Lor, a Hmong teenager who tried to steal Kowalski's prized possession: a 1972 Gran Torino.

movies.title: El mesero
movies.cast: Vadhir Derbez, Bárbara López, Arturo Barba, Emiliano Zurita, Ignacia Allamand, Gustavo Sánchez Parra
movies.overview: A waiter pretends to be an important businessman in order to reach the upper class through his entrepreneurial dreams.

movies.title: Bingo: The King of the Mornings
movies.cast: Vladimir Brichta, Leandra Leal, Tainá Müller, Augusto Madeira, Ana Lúcia Torre, Cauã Martins
movies.overview: 1980s. Brazilian television exploding in color and auditorium programs not so politically correct. In the middle of this fervor, Augusto Mendes, a young rising actor, seeks his place in the sun. From porn studios to soap operas, he finally finds success and fame when he becomes "Bingo", a TV host clown from one of the audience leader TV shows for children. It turns out that behind the rice powder and red nose, nobody knows who he is.

movies.title: Under the Same Moon
movies.cast: Adrian Alonso, Kate del Castillo, Eugenio Derbez, Maya Zapata, Carmen Salinas, Angelina Peláez
movies.country: Mexico, United States of America, France
movies.overview: Tells the parallel stories of nine-year-old Carlitos and his mother, Rosario. In the hopes of providing a better life for her son, Rosario works illegally in the U.S. while her mother cares for Carlitos back in Mexico.

movies.title: The Hidden Fortress
movies.cast: Toshirō Mifune, Minoru Chiaki, Kamatari Fujiwara, Misa Uehara, Susumu Fujita, Takashi Shimura
movies.overview: In feudal Japan, during a bloody war between clans, two cowardly and greedy peasants, soldiers of a defeated army, stumble upon a mysterious man who guides them to a fortress hidden in the mountains.

movies.title: Room
movies.cast: Brie Larson, Jacob Tremblay, Joan Allen, Sean Bridgers, Tom McCamus, William H. Macy
movies.country: Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

movies.title: Close-Up
movies.cast: Hossain Sabzian, Abolfazl Ahankhah, Mehrdad Ahankhah, Nayer Mohseni Zonoozi, Ahmad Reza Moayed Mohseni, Mohsen Makhmalbaf
movies.overview: This fiction-documentary hybrid uses a sensational real-life event—the arrest of a young man on charges that he fraudulently impersonated the well-known filmmaker Mohsen Makhmalbaf—as the basis for a stunning, multilayered investigation into movies, identity, artistic creation, and existence, in which the real people from the case play themselves.

movies.cast: George MacKay, Dean-Charles Chapman, Mark Strong, Andrew Scott, Richard Madden, Claire Duburcq
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom, Spain, India
movies.overview: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

movies.title: Loving Vincent
movies.cast: Douglas Booth, Robert Gulaczyk, Eleanor Tomlinson, Helen McCrory, Saoirse Ronan, Chris O'Dowd
movies.overview: A young man arrives at the last hometown of painter Vincent van Gogh to deliver the troubled artist's final letter and ends up investigating his final days there.

movies.title: Gifted
movies.cast: Chris Evans, Mckenna Grace, Lindsay Duncan, Jenny Slate, Octavia Spencer, Glenn Plummer
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Frank, a single man raising his child prodigy niece Mary, is drawn into a custody battle with his mother.

movies.title: Guillermo del Toro's Pinocchio
movies.cast: Ewan McGregor, David Bradley, Gregory Mann, Burn Gorman, Ron Perlman, John Turturro
movies.overview: During the rise of fascism in Mussolini's Italy, a wooden boy brought magically to life struggles to live up to his father's expectations.

movies.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
movies.cast: Gregory Peck, Mary Badham, Phillip Alford, John Megna, Frank Overton, Brock Peters
movies.overview: Scout Finch, 6, and her older brother Jem live in sleepy Maycomb, Alabama, spending much of their time with their friend Dill and spying on their reclusive and mysterious neighbor, Boo Radley. When Atticus, their widowed father and a respected lawyer, defends a black man named Tom Robinson against fabricated rape charges, the trial and tangent events expose the children to evils of racism and stereotyping.

movies.title: Something the Lord Made
movies.cast: Alan Rickman, Yasiin Bey, Kyra Sedgwick, Gabrielle Union, Merritt Wever, Charles S. Dutton
movies.overview: A dramatization of the relationship between heart surgery pioneers Alfred Blalock and Vivien Thomas.

movies.title: Catch Me If You Can
movies.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Christopher Walken, Martin Sheen, Nathalie Baye, Amy Adams
movies.overview: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.

movies.title: Transformers One
movies.cast: Chris Hemsworth, Brian Tyree Henry, Scarlett Johansson, Keegan-Michael Key, Jon Hamm, Steve Buscemi
movies.overview: The untold origin story of Optimus Prime and Megatron, better known as sworn enemies, but once were friends bonded like brothers who changed the fate of Cybertron forever.

movies.title: Song of the Sea
movies.cast: David Rawle, Brendan Gleeson, Lisa Hannigan, Fionnula Flanagan, Lucy O'Connell, Jon Kenny
movies.country: Ireland, Luxembourg, Belgium, Denmark, United Kingdom, France
movies.overview: The story of the last Seal Child’s journey home. After their mother’s disappearance, Ben and Saoirse are sent to live with Granny in the city. When they resolve to return to their home by the sea, their journey becomes a race against time as they are drawn into a world Ben knows only from his mother’s folktales. But this is no bedtime story; these fairy folk have been in our world far too long. It soon becomes clear to Ben that Saoirse is the key to their survival.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.cast: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum, Richard Attenborough, Bob Peck, Martin Ferrero
movies.overview: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.

movies.title: Ultraman: Rising
movies.cast: Christopher Sean, Gedde Watanabe, Tamlyn Tomita, Keone Young, Julia Harriman, Hiro Nakamura
movies.overview: A star athlete reluctantly returns home to take over his father's duties as Ultraman, shielding Tokyo from giant monsters as he becomes a legendary hero.

movies.title: The Imitation Game
movies.cast: Benedict Cumberbatch, Keira Knightley, Matthew Goode, Rory Kinnear, Allen Leech, Matthew Beard
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボール超 ブロリー
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Aya Hisakawa, Ryo Horikawa, Toshio Furukawa, Takeshi Kusao, Ryusei Nakao
movies.overview: Earth is peaceful following the Tournament of Power. Realizing that the universes still hold many more strong people yet to see, Goku spends all his days training to reach even greater heights. Then one day, Goku and Vegeta are faced by a Saiyan called 'Broly' who they've never seen before. The Saiyans were supposed to have been almost completely wiped out in the destruction of Planet Vegeta, so what's this one doing on Earth? This encounter between the three Saiyans who have followed completely different destinies turns into a stupendous battle, with even Frieza (back from Hell) getting caught up in the mix.

movies.title: The Legend of La Llorona
movies.cast: Rafael Inclán, Yair Prado, Mónica del Carmen, Mayté Cordero, Rosario Zúñiga, Mercedes Hernández
movies.overview: Based on a famous Mexican legend, a group of kids must stop the ghost of a woman whose guilt over the drowning of her own children leads her to abduct youngsters who wander the woods at night.

movies.title: Paper Lives
movies.cast: Çağatay Ulusoy, Emir Ali Doğrul, Ersin Arıcı, Turgay Tanülkü, Selen Öztürk, Tomris Çetinel
movies.overview: In the streets of Istanbul, ailing waste warehouse worker Mehmet takes a small boy under his wing and must soon confront his own traumatic childhood.

movies.title: We Are the Nobles
movies.cast: Gonzalo Vega, Luis Gerardo Méndez, Karla Souza, Juan Pablo Gil, Ianis Guerrero, Mario Haddad
movies.overview: Tells the "riches to rags" story of the Nobles, three upper-class twenty-somethings that appear to have no limits to their checkbooks, and no direction in their lives. Until one day, their father tries to teach them a lesson by staging a financial scandal that forces the whole family to escape to an old house in the poor side of town, and leads the "kids" to do what they haven't done before: get jobs.

movies.title: Tae Guk Gi: The Brotherhood of War
movies.cast: Jang Dong-gun, Won Bin, Lee Eun-ju, Gong Hyung-jin, Lee Young-ran, Jang Min-ho
movies.country: South Korea, United States of America
movies.overview: When two brothers are forced to fight in the Korean War, the elder decides to take the riskiest missions if it will help shield the younger from battle.

movies.title: Castle in the Sky
movies.cast: Keiko Yokozawa, Mayumi Tanaka, Minori Terada, Kotoe Hatsui, Fujio Tokita, Ichiro Nagai
movies.overview: A young boy and a girl with a magic crystal must race against pirates and foreign agents in a search for a legendary floating castle.

movies.title: Autumn Sonata
movies.cast: Ingrid Bergman, Liv Ullmann, Lena Nyman, Halvar Björk, Marianne Aminoff, Arne Bang-Hansen
movies.overview: After a seven-year absence, Charlotte Andergast travels to Sweden to reunite with her daughter Eva. The pair have a troubled relationship: Charlotte sacrificed the responsibilities of motherhood for a career as a classical pianist. Over an emotional night, the pair reopen the wounds of the past. Charlotte gets another shock when she finds out that her mentally impaired daughter, Helena, is out of the asylum and living with Eva.

movies.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
movies.cast: Maria Falconetti, Eugène Silvain, André Berley, Maurice Schutz, Antonin Artaud, Michel Simon
movies.overview: A classic of the silent age, this film tells the story of the doomed but ultimately canonized 15th-century teenage warrior. On trial for claiming she'd spoken to God, Jeanne d'Arc is subjected to inhumane treatment and scare tactics at the hands of church court officials. Initially bullied into changing her story, Jeanne eventually opts for what she sees as the truth. Her punishment, a famously brutal execution, earns her perpetual martyrdom.

movies.title: Aliens
movies.cast: Sigourney Weaver, Carrie Henn, Michael Biehn, Paul Reiser, Lance Henriksen, Bill Paxton
movies.overview: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
movies.cast: Uma Thurman, Lucy Liu, Vivica A. Fox, Daryl Hannah, David Carradine, Michael Madsen
movies.overview: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.

movies.title: Chungking Express
movies.cast: Brigitte Lin Ching-hsia, Takeshi Kaneshiro, Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Faye Wong, Valerie Chow, Piggy Chan Kam-Chuen
movies.overview: Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal server at a late-night restaurant.

movies.title: Bo Burnham: Inside
movies.cast: Bo Burnham
movies.overview: Stuck in COVID-19 lockdown, US comedian and musician Bo Burnham attempts to stay sane and happy by writing, shooting and performing a one-man comedy special.

movies.title: Weathering with You
movies.cast: Kotaro Daigo, Nana Mori, Tsubasa Honda, Sakura Kiryu, Sei Hiraizumi, Chieko Baisho
movies.overview: The summer of his high school freshman year, Hodaka runs away from his remote island home to Tokyo, and quickly finds himself pushed to his financial and personal limits. The weather is unusually gloomy and rainy every day, as if taking its cue from his life. After many days of solitude, he finally finds work as a freelance writer for a mysterious occult magazine. Then, one day, Hodaka meets Hina on a busy street corner. This bright and strong-willed girl possesses a strange and wonderful ability: the power to stop the rain and clear the sky.

movies.title: Paperman
movies.cast: John Kahrs, Kari Wahlgren, Jeff Turley, Jack Goldenberg
movies.overview: An urban office worker finds that paper airplanes are instrumental in meeting a girl in ways he never expected.

movies.title: Kung Fu Soccer
movies.cast: Zhang Xiaofei, Dilraba Dilmurat, Zhang Yixing, Carina Lau, Hu Yu'an, Sisley Choi Si-pui
movies.overview: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

movies.title: Bitter Christmas
movies.cast: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Victoria Luengo, Patrick Criado, Milena Smit
movies.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

movies.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
movies.cast: Joshua Garcia, Julia Barretto, Chanda Romero, Bianca Umali, Joy Barcoma, Karen Reyes
movies.overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

movies.title: Hershey
movies.cast: Finn Wittrock, Alexandra Daddario, Alan Ruck, Richard Kind, David Costabile, Heléne Yorke
movies.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

movies.title: Josephine
movies.cast: Mason Reeves, Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Philip Ettinger, Syra McCarthy, Eleanore Pienta
movies.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

movies.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
movies.cast: Cameron Mathison, Maya Skabar, Jill Wagner, Kendon Chase, Tonjha Richardson, John James
movies.overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

movies.title: 5 Centimeters per Second
movies.cast: Hokuto Matsumura, Mitsuki Takahata, Yuzu Aoki, Nana Mori, Mai Kiryu, Haruto Ueda
movies.overview: After transferring to the same elementary school, Takaki and Akari become fast friends, bonding over the constant upheaval of moving from town to town. Just as their feelings for each other start to blossom, their shared happiness comes to an end when both of their families are forced to relocate. As the seasons change, Takaki and Akari begin to wonder if they will ever be able to see each other again, and share their secret feelings.

movies.title: Being Heumann
movies.cast: Ruth Madeley, Mark Ruffalo, Dylan O'Brien, Madeline Delp, Roberta Colindrez, Jon Beavers
movies.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

movies.title: DNK
movies.cast: Mouli, Sushmita Shetty, Ali, Raghu Babu, Rajitha, Bhadram
movies.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

movies.title: V for Vendetta
movies.cast: Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea, Stephen Fry, John Hurt, Tim Pigott-Smith
movies.country: Germany, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: In a world in which Great Britain has become a fascist state, a masked vigilante known only as “V” conducts guerrilla warfare against the oppressive British government. When V rescues a young woman from the secret police, he finds in her an ally with whom he can continue his fight to free the people of Britain.

movies.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
movies.original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : L’Âge de fer
movies.cast: Simon Abkarian, Simon Russell Beale, Florian Lesieur, Benoît Magimel, Mathieu Kassovitz, Loïc Corbery
movies.country: France, Belgium, United States of America
movies.overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

movies.title: Lilo & Scratch
movies.cast: Chris Sanders, Maia Kealoha
movies.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

movies.title: The Host
movies.cast: Song Kang-ho, Byun Hee-bong, Park Hae-il, Bae Doona, Ko Asung, Oh Dal-su
movies.overview: A teenage girl is captured by a giant mutated squid-like creature that appears from Seoul's Han River after toxic waste was dumped in it, prompting her family into a frantic search for her.

movies.title: All of a Sudden
movies.cast: Virginie Efira, Tao Okamoto, Kyōzō Nagatsuka, Kodai Kurosaki, Jean-Charles Clichet, Marie Bunel
movies.overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

movies.cast: Chaithra J Achar, Charan Lakkaraju, Preethi Pagadala, Ramesh Indira, Shashank Patil, Shree Vaishnav
movies.overview: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

movies.title: Minotaur
movies.cast: Dmitriy Mazurov, Iris Lebedeva, Varvara Shmykova, Juris Žagars, Anatoliy Belyy, Vladimir Friedman
movies.country: France, Latvia, United States of America, Switzerland, Germany
movies.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

movies.title: Marie Antoinette
movies.cast: Kirsten Dunst, Jason Schwartzman, Steve Coogan, Judy Davis, Rip Torn, Asia Argento
movies.country: Japan, United States of America, France
movies.overview: A retelling of the story of France’s iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette - from her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at fifteen to her reign as queen at nineteen and ultimately the fall of Versailles.

movies.title: Wild at Heart
movies.cast: Nicolas Cage, Laura Dern, Willem Dafoe, Diane Ladd, Harry Dean Stanton, J.E. Freeman
movies.overview: Young lovers Sailor and Lula hit the road to start a new life together away from the wrath of Lula’s deranged, disapproving mother, who has hired a team of hitmen to cut the lovers’ surreal honeymoon short.

movies.title: The Mosquito Bowl
movies.cast: Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson, Tom Francis, Brent Comer, Jack Ingram
movies.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

movies.title: Udta Teer
movies.cast: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, Rahul Bose, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala, Ram Kapoor
movies.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

movies.title: ENE Repeat
movies.cast: Vishwak Sen, Abhinav Gomatam, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Maganti Srinath, Meher Ramesh, Anisha Ambrose
movies.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

movies.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
movies.cast: Chris Colfer, Alice Krige, Daniel Adegboyega, Declan Reynolds, Gabriela Garcia Vargas, Matthew McMahon
movies.overview: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

movies.title: Confession
movies.cast: Rob Lowe, James Franco, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Kodi Smit-McPhee, Nick Nolte, Richard Brake
movies.overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

movies.title: When a Witness Recants
movies.cast: Ta-Nehisi Coates, Ransom Watkins, Andrew Stewart, Alfred Chestnut, Ron Bishop
movies.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

movies.title: Paradise Lost
movies.cast: Kim Hyun-joo, Bae Hyeon-seong, Kim Jong-tae, Lee Hyun-kyun, Lee Yoo-joo, Yu Ji-wan
movies.overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

movies.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
movies.cast: Chen Yiwen, Fu Chong, Churong Fan, Zhang Anqi, Jia	Qiu, Sun Chang
movies.overview: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

movies.title: Everytime
movies.cast: Birgit Minichmayr, Lotte Keiling, Tristán López, Carla Hüttermann, Hermann Beyer, Eva Weißenborn
movies.overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.cast: Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, Jack Black, Eli Wallach, Edward Burns
movies.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.cast: Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, Halle Bailey, Colton Ryan, Eldar Isgandarov, K. Todd Freeman
movies.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: Behemoth!
movies.cast: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Will Arnett, Hank Azaria, Alexa Swinton
movies.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

movies.title: November 1963
movies.cast: John Travolta, Robert Carlyle, Dermot Mulroney, Jefferson White, Mandy Patinkin, Thomas Fiscella
movies.country: United States of America, Canada, Germany
movies.overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

movies.title: The Muppets
movies.cast: Jason Segel, Amy Adams, Chris Cooper, Rashida Jones, Steve Whitmire, Peter Linz
movies.overview: When Kermit the Frog and the Muppets learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his felt-faced brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a telethon show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.cast: Deva Cassel, Jamie Ward, Jim Caviezel, Sam Worthington, Ben Mendelsohn, Gael García Bernal
movies.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

movies.title: Rose
movies.cast: Sandra Hüller, Caro Braun, Marisa Growaldt, Robert Gwisdek, Godehard Giese, Maria Dragus
movies.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

movies.title: Flavia
movies.cast: Molly Belle Wright, Martin Freeman, Toby Jones, Jonathan Pryce, Annette Badland, Karan Gill
movies.country: United Kingdom, Canada, United States of America
movies.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

movies.title: Ink
movies.cast: Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce, Claire Foy, Blake Harrison, Patrick Kennedy, Angus Imrie
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France
movies.overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

movies.title: Above the Below
movies.cast: Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, Hero Fiennes Tiffin
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

movies.title: The Gallerist
movies.cast: Natalie Portman, Jenna Ortega, Zach Galifianakis, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Sterling K. Brown, Daniel Brühl
movies.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

movies.title: The Fox
movies.cast: Jai Courtney, Emily Browning, Olivia Colman, Claudia Doumit, Peter O'Brien, Sam Neill
movies.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
movies.cast: George Michael
movies.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: Tangles
movies.cast: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston, Samira Wiley, Beanie Feldstein, Seth Rogen
movies.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

movies.title: Tender Loving Care
movies.cast: Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson, Kate O'Flynn, Alice Bailey Johnson, Tilly Vosburgh, Alan Williams
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Singapore
movies.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

movies.title: 14th
movies.cast: Sherrilyn Ifill, Stacey Abrams, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jeff Flake, Hasan Piker, Alex Padilla
movies.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

movies.title: Bunker
movies.cast: Javier Bardem, Penélope Cruz, Stephen Graham, Paul Dano, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Chloe Conh
movies.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

movies.title: GROTESQQQUE
movies.cast: Kana Ichinose, Gen Hoshino, Sara Minami, Ikumi Hasegawa, Saori Hayami, Maaya Uchida
movies.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with her servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

movies.title: A Long Winter
movies.cast: Fred Hechinger, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Caitríona Balfe, Kit Connor, D'Pharaoh Woon-A-Tai, David Furr
movies.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

movies.title: In Waves
movies.cast: Rio Vega, Lyna Khoudri, Paul Kircher, Birane Ba, Gauthier Battoue, Taiana Tully
movies.country: France, Belgium, United States of America
movies.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

movies.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
movies.cast: Cameron Winter
movies.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

movies.title: Killing Castro
movies.cast: Diego Boneta, Xolo Maridueña, KiKi Layne, Al Pacino, Alexander Ludwig, Kendrick Sampson
movies.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

movies.title: Eternal Return
movies.cast: Naomi Scott, Kit Harington, Sonoya Mizuno, Jay Lycurgo, Simon Callow
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

movies.title: Clarissa
movies.cast: Sophie Okonedo, David Oyelowo, India Ria Amarteifio, Ayo Edebiri, Toheeb Jimoh, Nikki Amuka-Bird
movies.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

movies.title: The Day She Returns
movies.cast: Song Seon-mi, Cho Yun-hee, Park Mi-so, Kim Sun-jin, O Yoon-soo, Kang So-yi
movies.overview: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

movies.title: Ben'Imana
movies.cast: Clémentine U. Nyirinkindi, Kesia Kelly Nishimwe, Arivere Kagoyire, Isabelle Kabano, Antoinette Uwamahoro, Leocadie Uwabeza
movies.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

movies.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
movies.original_title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
movies.cast: Jeevan Braich, Kayna Montecillo, Jade Marvin, Olivia Ringrose, Asher Forth, Sophie Naglik
movies.overview: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

movies.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
movies.cast: Soraya Akhlaghi
movies.country: Iran, France, United Kingdom, United States of America, Denmark
movies.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

movies.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.original_title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.cast: Tom Sizemore, Robert LaSardo, Celine Alva, Daniel Baldwin, Tony Devon, Bai Ling
movies.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

movies.title: The Friend's House is Here
movies.cast: Mahshad Bahram, Hana Mana, Farzad Karen, Zohreh Pirnia, Parham Ghanavat, Erfan Tehranifar
movies.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

movies.title: To Hold a Mountain
movies.cast: Mileva Gara Jovanović, Nada Stanišić
movies.country: Serbia, France, Montenegro, Slovenia, Croatia, Belgium
movies.overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

movies.title: Starlight
movies.cast: Michael Brando, Irmena Chichikova, Cassie Clare, Ruby Kammer, Brice Bexter, Lesley Conroy
movies.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

movies.title: A Little Dream of Me
movies.original_title: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi
movies.cast: Kaycee, Trần Doãn Hoàng, Nguyễn Hùng, Hữu Châu, Phương Nam, Tào Nhân
movies.overview: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi is an emotional journey of young people searching for answers to the question, “What is your dream?”—only to discover, as they step into adulthood, that the most important question becomes, “Who do you want to pursue that dream with?”

movies.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
movies.original_title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
movies.cast: Aoife Josie Clements, Louise Weard, Ada Rook, Vera Drew, Dakota Blais, Penny Andrews
movies.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

movies.title: Bad Medicine
movies.cast: Dr Michael Yeadon, Dr Paul Marik, Andrew Cuomo, Dr Vladimir Zelenko, Dr. Moehanid Talia, Erin Olszewsky
movies.overview: Bad Medicine follows the trail of hard evidence while laying out a step-by-step exposé of the tricks and tactics used to capture and control entire populations. Without understanding these methods we will remain vulnerable to future psychological operations.

movies.title: Straight Circle
movies.cast: Elliott Tittensor, Luke Tittensor, Neil Maskell, Matthew Dylan Roberts, Camilla Waldman, Catriona Andrew
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

movies.title: Alias Rukmini
movies.cast: Nithiin, Aafiya Sayed
movies.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

movies.title: THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE.
movies.cast: RAYE, Amma, Absolutely
movies.overview: Filmed live at the Royal Albert Hall with 117 musicians and special appearances by her family, this concert film unfolds across four season-inspired acts as RAYE reimagines her album amid 11 nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards.

movies.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii..
movies.cast: Gauri Malla, Tripti Nadakar, Rekha Thapa, Mahesh Tripathi, Deeya Maskey, Manoj Gajurel
movies.overview: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

movies.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
movies.cast: Mark Lewis, Mike Majlak, Sam Dale, Sam Dale, Ben Kersley, Ben Kersley
movies.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

movies.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
movies.cast: Soroya Clayton-Wright, Lil Champ, Loretta Robinson, Miles Caton, Guillaume Marbeck, Debbii Dawson
movies.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

movies.title: Drinking and Driving
movies.cast: Jillian Frank, Avalon Fast, Ethan Hawksworth, Henri Gillespi, Payton Berg, Sophie Bawks-Smith
movies.overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

movies.title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
movies.cast: Joy "Babygirl" Carter, Mona Gilliam
movies.overview: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

movies.title: What Happened On November 1st?
movies.cast: Angelina Jackson, Grace Damiani, Simone Alexa Lupo, Ivereigh Tarateta, Alexis Kihiko, Dashiell Fisher
movies.overview: A whole college skips the second day of Halloweekend to celebrate Christmas on November 1st. Dressing festive, watching Christmas movies and playing music. However, there's a mystery...why and how are people getting murdered on November 1st?

movies.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
movies.original_title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
movies.cast: Omowunmi Dada, Bimbo Manuel, Odunlade Adekola, Tina Mba, Bisola Aiyeola, Nkechi Blessing
movies.overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

movies.title: Prince: 3121 Las Vegas Live
movies.cast: Prince
movies.overview: Prepare for an electrifying, once in a lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.

movies.title: Parallel
movies.cast: Aayed Farhan, Danish Farhan, Ayden Farhan
movies.overview: An eleven-year-old boy discovers a secret project that completely shatters his understanding of reality. He must race to uncover the truth before the forces behind the operation alter his life forever.

movies.title: A Dot in the Ocean
movies.cast: Heath Miller, Demi Marie Miller, Nathan Taupez Scinto
movies.overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

movies.title: Seldom Seen
movies.overview: Final entry in Sandman Series trilogy.

movies.title: Captain Bonanza!
movies.cast: Conrad White, May Columb, Sidonius White, Merrick Williams, Nino Perricone, Sasha Danilov
movies.overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

movies.title: Prodigal Son
movies.overview: Aaron "Amadeus" Overlake is a visionary filmmaker revered for his genius but plagued by his own demons—a volatile alcoholic whose life is consumed by anger, controversy, and from a bitter heartbreak. As tabloids revel in his self-destruction, Aaron’s only anchor is his best friend, Santiago "Baron" Gonzalez, a charismatic actor fresh out of rehab, fighting to rebuild his career.  Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

movies.title: The Raven of Baltimore City
movies.cast: Eli Sandhaus, Matthew Mills, Jenny Kuhlthau, Matt Boykin, Jackie Letkowski, Joey Pelletier
movies.overview: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

movies.title: Split Mica
movies.director: Joseline Mendoza, Isabel Tafoya, Row Särkelä Bassett
movies.cast: Joseline Mendoza, Isabel Tafoya, Row Särkelä Bassett, Ben Erickson, Melissa Chambers, Georgia Gersh
movies.overview: Finding themselves haunted by a similar monster, three New Mexicans reckon with the complexities of calling a place home.

movies.title: American Baby
movies.cast: Abigail Pniowsky, Elisha Henig, Claire Capek, Janel Koloski
movies.overview: Oli becomes an outcast in her community when she gets pregnant at 15. As she seeks out the suddenly absent teenage father-to-be, Oli confronts the growing isolation from her community.

movies.title: Cuckoo's Nest
movies.cast: Michael Chobanoff, Eliana Romero, Guy Holling
movies.overview: 72 hours after her mother disappears, a young girl watches her father descend into madness after he comes across a strange egg in their chicken coop.

movies.title: 1-DAY ADULT
movies.cast: Elias ZX
movies.overview: So, essentially, from what I can glean, the “Minions” are a series of films about these little yellow creatures, a sickly old man and also his wife (?). They sing and dance to popular songs and they have all been very friendly to me. This is a film about a theme park in Singapore.

movies.title: Precipice
movies.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

movies.title: Sindure Jatra
movies.cast: Bijay Baral, Anjana Baraili, Binod Neupane, Usha Khadgi, Ram Prasad Khanal, Lokendra Lekhak
movies.overview: A gambler risks his marriage by staking his wife in a high-stakes game, only to lose her and face a painful struggle for redemption as he confronts his addiction, pride, and the consequences of his actions.

movies.title: Gym “Hometown Hero” Doc
movies.cast: Dylan Shwarting, Dylan Shwarting, Leone Bartolani, Dylan Shwarting
movies.overview: Dylan Shwarting goes through his gym routine and shares his experience

movies.title: The Jungle
movies.cast: Nora Kniffen, Finn Jordan
movies.overview: Mariah is stuck in a self-destructive cycle of partying until she reconnects with an old friend who helps her rediscover her identity.

movies.title: Without a Trace
movies.cast: Vincent Jarus, Alex Loncaric, Laurens Denison, Indeya Simon, Annie Denison, Kendall Siefert
movies.overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

movies.title: Just Relax
movies.overview: A troubled young woman undergoes a supernatural meditation for memory loss and discovers something more twisted than she ever could have imagined.

movies.title: Subway City
movies.overview: 3.5 million travelers use the New York subway system every day. Briefcase wielding city workers share their morning rides with peddlers, street musicians, the down and out, pickpockets, and drug addicts. This film explores the underground world in all its diversity, from the frenetic rush hour traffic to the eerie solitude of early morning runs. Besides those who merely use the subway as transportation, there are those who work there, those who live there, and those who commit crimes there.

movies.title: Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me
movies.cast: Selena Gomez, Raquelle Stevens, Ashley Cook, Liana Blackburn, Brent L. Boxberger, Devyck Bull
movies.overview: After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness. This uniquely raw and intimate documentary spans her six-year journey into a new light.

movies.title: Night and Fog
movies.cast: Michel Bouquet, Reinhard Heydrich, Heinrich Himmler, Adolf Hitler, Julius Streicher
movies.overview: Filmmaker Alain Resnais documents the atrocities behind the walls of Hitler's concentration camps.

movies.title: Baraka
movies.cast: Patrick Disanto
movies.overview: A paralysingly beautiful documentary with a global vision—an odyssey through landscape and time—that attempts to capture the essence of life.

movies.title: One Direction: This Is Us
movies.cast: Harry Styles, Zayn Malik, Niall Horan, Louis Tomlinson, Liam Payne, Simon Cowell
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: "One Direction: This Is Us" is a captivating and intimate all-access look at life on the road for the global music phenomenon. Weaved with stunning live concert footage, this inspiring feature film tells the remarkable story of Niall, Zayn, Liam, Harry and Louis' meteoric rise to fame, from their humble hometown beginnings and competing on the X-Factor, to conquering the world and performing at London’s famed O2 Arena. Hear it from the boys themselves and see through their own eyes what it's really like to be One Direction.

movies.title: BLACKPINK: Light Up the Sky
movies.cast: JISOO, JENNIE, ROSÉ, LISA, TEDDY
movies.overview: Record-shattering Korean girl band BLACKPINK tell their story —  and detail the hard fought journey of the dreams and trials behind their meteoric rise.

movies.title: Senna
movies.cast: Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost, Frank Williams, Ron Dennis, Viviane Senna, Milton da Silva
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France
movies.overview: The remarkable story of Brazilian racing driver Ayrton Senna, charting his physical and spiritual achievements on the track and off, his quest for perfection, and the mythical status he has since attained, is the subject of Senna, a documentary feature that spans the racing legend's years as an F1 driver, from his opening season in 1984 to his untimely death a decade later.

movies.title: The Salt of the Earth
movies.cast: Sebastião Salgado, Wim Wenders, Juliano Ribeiro Salgado, Hugo Barbier, Lélia Wanick Salgado, Jacques Barthélémy
movies.overview: During the last forty years, the photographer Sebastião Salgado has been travelling through the continents, in the footsteps of an ever-changing humanity. He has witnessed the major events of our recent history: international conflicts, starvations and exodus… He is now embarking on the discovery of pristine territories, of the wild fauna and flora, of grandiose landscapes: a huge photographic project which is a tribute to the planet's beauty. Salgado's life and work are revealed to us by his son, Juliano, who went with him during his last journeys, and by Wim Wenders, a photographer himself.

movies.title: Camembert
movies.cast: Kristin Scott Thomas, Alex Lutz, Pascale Arbillot, Bernard Le Coq, Guillermo Guiz, Bertrand Goncalves

movies.title: Jupiter
movies.cast: Denis Ménochet, Ella Rumpf, Céline Sallette, Dominique Blanc, Reda Kateb, André Dussollier
movies.overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

movies.title: The Gospel of Christmas
movies.cast: Fantasia Barrino, Tank, Mason Douglas, Eric Wiltz, John Gray, Hezekiah Walker
movies.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

movies.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
movies.cast: Ko Shibasaki, Eiji Akaso, Michitaka Tsutsui, Naomi Nishida, Yui Narumi, Ryubi Miyase
movies.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

movies.overview: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

movies.title: Model Citizen

movies.overview: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

movies.title: The Birthday​ Gift​

movies.overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

movies.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

movies.title: La Gradiva

movies.overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

movies.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex

movies.overview: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

movies.title: The Storm
movies.cast: Gustaf Skarsgård, Aliette Opheim, Filip Berg, Josephine Bornebusch, Jonas Karlsson, Johan Rheborg
movies.overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

movies.title: Je so’ pazzo
movies.cast: Massimiliano Caiazzo, Mariasole Pollio, Giovanni Ludeno, Giuseppe Brunetti, Leonardo Bianconi, Giampiero De Concilio
movies.overview: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

movies.title: Les Misérables
movies.cast: Vincent Lindon, Tahar Rahim, Camille Cottin, Benjamin Lavernhe, Noémie Merlant, Vassili Schneider
movies.overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

movies.title: Iron Boy
movies.cast: Gary Clichy, Rod Paradot, Dimitri Colas, Aurélie Vassort, Brune Moulin, Alexandre Astier
movies.overview: 11-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm in rural France. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief.

movies.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
movies.director: David Moreau, Renee Zhan, RZA, Ernest R. Dickerson, Flying Lotus, Tobias Forge

movies.overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

movies.title: Therapy Done Right
movies.cast: Ricardo Darín, Diego Peretti, Inés Efrón, Carlos Santamaría, Miriam Odorico, Antonia Bengochea
movies.overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

movies.title: The Spiral

movies.overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

movies.title: All About Corinne

movies.overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

movies.title: Doing Life

movies.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

movies.overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

movies.title: Baththa

movies.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

movies.title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
movies.original_title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part

movies.overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

movies.title: A Man of His Time
movies.cast: Swann Arlaud, Sandrine Blancke, Mathieu Perotto, Harpo Guit, Mathilde Abd El Kader, Jean-Baptiste Marre
movies.overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

movies.title: Il mio nome è Carlo

But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

movies.title: Despicable Me
movies.cast: Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand, Miranda Cosgrove, Dana Gaier Ellis, Elsie Fisher

To pull it off, he adopts three orphaned girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—intending to use them as pawns in his scheme. But the unexpected bond they form forces him to question the criminal life he's always known.

His friends will come to try to help him and get out of there as soon as possible. But it is no coincidence that the Charro has chosen to involve Leo, his intentions go beyond getting a new soul.

movies.title: Tangled

From Harlan's dysfunctional family to his devoted staff, Blanc sifts through a web of red herrings and self-serving lies to uncover the truth behind Harlan's untimely death.

But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.

movies.overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

movies.title: Thor

movies.overview: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

movies.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.original_title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Jesse Eisenberg, Gal Gadot, Amy Adams, Diane Lane
movies.overview: Fearing the actions of a god-like Super Hero left unchecked, Gotham City’s own formidable, forceful vigilante takes on Metropolis’s most revered, modern-day savior, while the world wrestles with what sort of hero it really needs. And with Batman and Superman at war with one another, a new threat quickly arises, putting mankind in greater danger than it’s ever known before.

movies.title: Logan
movies.cast: Hugh Jackman, Dafne Keen, Patrick Stewart, Elizabeth Rodriguez, Boyd Holbrook, Stephen Merchant
movies.overview: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

movies.title: Cars 2

Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2

Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

Wanting to prove he can be a good guy and not just a villain, Ralph escapes his game and lands in Hero's Duty, a first-person shooter where he helps the game's hero battle against alien invaders. He later enters Sugar Rush, a kart racing game set on tracks made of candies, cookies and other sweets. movies.title: A Frozen Flower
movies.cast: Zo In-sung, Joo Jin-mo, Song Ji-hyo, Shim Ji-ho, Lim Ju-hwan, Yeo Wook-hwan
movies.overview: A despotic king orders his male lover to produce an heir for him with his Queen. But when they instead fall in love, will tragic consequences follow?

movies.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
movies.original_title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
movies.cast: Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett, Taraji P. Henson, Julia Ormond, Jason Flemyng, Tilda Swinton
movies.overview: Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer. Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.

movies.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
movies.cast: Will Smith, Jaden Smith, Thandiwe Newton, Brian Howe, James Karen, Dan Castellaneta
movies.overview: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

movies.title: The Last Samurai
movies.cast: Tom Cruise, Ken Watanabe, Timothy Spall, Tony Goldwyn, Hiroyuki Sanada, Koyuki
movies.overview: Nathan Algren is an American hired to instruct the Japanese army in the ways of modern warfare, which finds him learning to respect the samurai and the honorable principles that rule them. Pressed to destroy the samurai's way of life in the name of modernization and open trade, Algren decides to become an ultimate warrior himself and to fight for their right to exist.

movies.title: Quantum of Solace
movies.cast: Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric, Judi Dench, Giancarlo Giannini, Gemma Arterton
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Betrayed by Vesper, the woman he loved, 007 fights the urge to make his latest mission personal. Pursuing his determination to uncover the truth, Bond and M interrogate Mr. White, who reveals that the organization that blackmailed Vesper is far more complex and dangerous than anyone had imagined.

movies.title: The Emperor's New Groove
movies.cast: David Spade, John Goodman, Eartha Kitt, Patrick Warburton, Wendie Malick, Kellyann Kelso
movies.overview: When the self‑absorbed Emperor Kuzco is accidentally transformed into a llama, he must rely on a humble villager to survive the jungle and reclaim his throne.

movies.title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
movies.cast: Matt Damon, James Cromwell, Daniel Studi, Chopper Bernet, Jeff LeBeau, John Rubano
movies.overview: Against impossible odds, Spirit, a young mustang, sets out across the majestic wilderness to regain his freedom and save his homeland. Along the way, he forms a friendship with a young Lakota brave, outwits a squadron of soldiers, and ultimately, finds love.

movies.title: Apocalypto
movies.cast: Rudy Youngblood, Raoul Max Trujillo, Gerardo Taracena, Iazua Larios, Antonio Monroy, María Isabel Díaz Lago
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

movies.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
movies.cast: Chow Yun-Fat, Michelle Yeoh, Zhang Ziyi, Chang Chen, Lung Sihung, Cheng Pei-pei
movies.country: Hong Kong, Taiwan, United States of America, China
movies.overview: Two warriors in pursuit of a stolen sword and a notorious fugitive are led to an impetuous, physically-skilled, teenage nobleman's daughter, who is at a crossroads in her life.

movies.title: Fantastic Four
movies.cast: Ioan Gruffudd, Jessica Alba, Chris Evans, Michael Chiklis, Julian McMahon, Hamish Linklater
movies.overview: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

movies.title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
movies.cast: Ray Romano, John Leguizamo, Denis Leary, Queen Latifah, Seann William Scott, Josh Peck
movies.overview: Diego, Manny and Sid return in this sequel to the hit animated movie Ice Age. This time around, the deep freeze is over, and the ice-covered earth is starting to melt, which will destroy the trio's cherished valley. The impending disaster prompts them to reunite and warn all the other beasts about the desperate situation.

movies.title: Shaolin Soccer
movies.cast: Stephen Chow, Richard Ng Man-tat, Zhao Wei, Patrick Tse Yin, Karen Mok Man-wai, Wong Yat-fei
movies.overview: A young Shaolin follower reunites with his discouraged brothers to form a soccer team using their martial art skills to their advantage.

movies.title: War of the Worlds
movies.cast: Tom Cruise, Dakota Fanning, Miranda Otto, Justin Chatwin, Tim Robbins, Rick Gonzalez
movies.overview: Ray Ferrier is a divorced dockworker and less-than-perfect father. Soon after his ex-wife and her new husband drop off his teenage son and young daughter for a rare weekend visit, a strange and powerful lightning storm touches down.

movies.title: The Passion of the Christ
movies.cast: Jim Caviezel, Maia Morgenstern, Christo Jivkov, Francesco De Vito, Monica Bellucci, Mattia Sbragia
movies.overview: A graphic portrayal of the last twelve hours of Jesus of Nazareth's life.

movies.title: Pan's Labyrinth
movies.cast: Ivana Baquero, Sergi López, Maribel Verdú, Doug Jones, Ariadna Gil, Álex Angulo
movies.country: Mexico, Spain, United States of America
